sources.title: Get the Model ID when i know the name of the model
sources.snippet: So I don't know about getting a project/model id from the name directly but what you can do to get the id is use the google cloud CLI. I've used the Google Cloud CLI for some projects of my own and I know that after you get your AI model deployed, you can use some CLI functions to get the model ID itself.
